safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states no neck stiffness; generated facts do not mention neck stiffness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute, severe headache, documenting absence of neck stiffness helps assess for meningitis or subarachnoid hemorrhage red flags. Omitting this negative finding can lead to unnecessary escalation or incomplete safety-netting/triage decisions later.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states no fever; generated facts do not mention fever.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Fever status is an important discriminator for infectious causes of headache (e.g., meningitis, encephalitis, systemic infection). Failure to document “no fever” can impair risk stratification and may prompt avoidable workup or missed context in follow-up care.
